name: Aria 2
driverConfig: 1 × 10mm TiN ceramic-coated spherical dome composite dynamic
pros: Solid metal build with replaceable brass nozzle
Low distortion and improved treble over original Aria
Great value for a metal single-DD
cons: Not the most resolving in class
Bass quantity may feel restrained for bassheads
insight: Aria 2 refines the classic Aria formula with a new TiN ceramic-coated driver, zinc alloy shell, and replaceable brass nozzle. It stays faithful to Moondrop’s VDSF target while improving technical performance and build quality, making it one of the strongest single-dynamic options under $100.
